Storefront and customer routes of the reviews module. Send `Accept-Language` (or `X-Locale` from a browser) on every call; a customer route needs the session cookie.

## DELETE /v1/reviews/{id}

Delete review

Parameters:

- `id` in path (string, required).

Responses:

- `204`: Review deleted.
- `401`: Unauthorized.
- `404`: Review not found.

## PATCH /v1/reviews/{id}

Update review

Parameters:

- `id` in path (string, required).

Request body: [UpdateReviewDto](#updatereviewdto).

Responses:

- `200`: Review updated.
- `400`: Invalid input.
- `401`: Unauthorized.
- `404`: Review not found.

## POST /v1/reviews/{id}/helpful

Mark review as helpful

Parameters:

- `id` in path (string, required).

Responses:

- `200`: Marked helpful.
- `201`: no description.
- `401`: Unauthorized.
- `404`: Review not found.

## Schemas

### UpdateReviewDto

- `rating` (number, min 1, max 5, optional).
- `title` (string, max length 200, optional).
- `body` (string, max length 5000, optional).
- `assetIds` (array of string, optional).
